Title: Monster Train Accessibility
Description: Full accessibility mod for totally blind players. Provides screen reader support via NVDA, JAWS, or Windows Narrator, and complete keyboard navigation for all game elements including menus, battles, card drafts, and map navigation.
ChangeLog: 8.0.0: mod keys moved off game keys (F2-F7, F9 settings, J, K, L, G), live combat narration with many new events, scene descriptions, map, reward, run history and run summary readers. See release-notes/v8.0.0.md
